title: Bigg Boss Telugu
plot_overview: The Telugu version of the reality show where a number of contestants (known as "housemates") live in a purpose-built house and are isolated from the rest of the world. Each week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction, and the housemates who receive the most nominations faces a public vote out.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: For season one, a lavish house set has been constructed in Lonavla.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Unlike the first season, this season featured general public along with celebrities as housemates. For this season, a lavish house set has been constructed in Annapurna Studios, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Bigg Boss Telugu is aired on Star Maa and also can be streamed on Hotstar. Every day's episodes contain the main happenings of the previous day. Weekend episodes mainly focuses on an interview of the evicted contestant by the host, Nagarjuna.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Bigg Boss 4 is the 4th season of the Telugu version of the indian reality television series Biggboss based on Dutch series Big Brother.The show premiered on 6 September 2020 on Star maa and Disney + Hotstar with  nagarjuna host for second time  , while Samantha appeared as a guest host for a week .
